evidence.claim: GitLab Security publishes exploitation-attempt detections for vulnerable self-managed GitLab CE/EE. Its linked Onigmo guidance identifies compile-time crash frames together with regexp_matcher.rb as corroborating traces of the CI path.
evidence.location: Detecting CVE-2026-97229 Exploitation Attempts and linked Onigmo native worker crash detection
